name: battery_foil_demo
provenance: SYNTHETIC demonstration, not plant data, for EV battery cathode current-collector foil. MATERIAL: 1235-H18 is the LITERATURE PROPOSAL (standard grade) of the catalogue's grade table for the final gauges of this case (>15-20 um band for 18 um, >10-13 um band for 12 um; band_products.proposed_material), to be confirmed or corrected by the plant: alloy and temper are NOT a plant statement (material.alloy_temper_stated false). ROUTE FROM THE PLANT (plant statements): the foil mill takes a 50 um input and reaches final gauge in TWO single-sheet passes; the final gauge is usually 17-19 um and can go down to 12 um. The intermediate gauge, the alloy and the temper were NOT stated: 30 um (50 -> 30 -> 18 um, 40 % per pass; published 34 -> 20 and 32 -> 17 um passes are its neighbours) is ASSUMED for the usual product and 25 um (50 -> 25 -> 12 um, 50 % then 52 %, matching the published 50 -> 25 -> 15 and 55 -> 25 -> 12 um passes) for the thinnest [battery report, catalogue product battery_collector_foil]. Every mill and material number below remains synthetic. Foil mill: single-stand four-high, work roll 0.27 m diameter (230-330 mm reported, 260-280 typical [V S8]), backup roll 0.75 m (2.8 x the work roll; 2.4-2.8 x reported [V S8]), barrel 1.5 m, strip 1.2 m centred. Half-stack masses and stiffnesses are planner ESTIMATES scaled from the sheet demo mill [D]: work roll 1100 kg (steel barrel pi*0.135^2*1.5*7850 = 674 kg plus necks and chocks), backup roll 9000 kg (barrel 5200 kg plus necks and chocks), work/backup contact 2.0e10 N/m (shorter, smaller-diameter contact than the sheet mill 4e10), housing 6.0e9 N/m (lighter foil stand; sheet mill 1.4e10); 3 m free spans. Schedule: S1-S3 0.26 -> 0.135 -> 0.085 -> 0.050 mm is an ASSUMED stock route down to the plant's 50 um input (48 %, 37 %, 41 %), then the plant's two passes F1 0.050 -> 0.030 mm (the case pass) and F2 0.030 -> 0.018 mm (final), then the thinnest product's ALTERNATIVE route ALT1 0.050 -> 0.025 mm and ALT2 0.025 -> 0.012 mm (52 %, inside the extended 65 % reduction domain). F2 and ALT2 lie below 20 um exit gauge: their roll bites come from the experimental mattress model in its extended domain (flag EXIT_GAUGE_BELOW_20_UM_EXTENDED_MATTRESS_DOMAIN; order of magnitude only; a bite whose force lies outside the range reported for battery-foil passes is marked not credible). The plant rolls the final pass single-sheet (material.final_pass_doubled false). material.product is battery_collector_foil (product check, evidence-neutral). Supplied mean flow stress 150 / 160 / 168 / 175 / 180 MPa along S1-F2 and 178 / 185 MPa for ALT1 / ALT2, inside the ranges of the standard proposal 1235-H18 (finished tensile strength 175-220 MPa at >15-20 um, at least 180 MPa at >10-13 um, 170-200 MPa at >20-30 um in the grade table; used as an indicator of flow stress only; no hardening law), so they are unchanged, friction 0.03 on every pass, tensions 30-38 / 35-42 MPa (entry 29-49, exit 34-44 MPa reported [V S3]), exit speeds 9.5 / 10.5 / 11.5 / 13 m/s on S1-F1 and ALT1 (570-780 m/min, inside the 550-1000 m/min published for earlier passes) and 10 m/s (600 m/min) on the single-sheet final passes F2 and ALT2 (inside the 450-650 m/min published for them), bite_model auto (Hitchcock solves S1-S3; it rejects the case pass and the experimental mattress model solves it, 0.96 kN/mm of width, inside the 0.9-2.3 kN/mm reported [V S3, S4]; the mattress model also gives F2, ALT1 and ALT2). Oil 1.6 mPa s (1.8-2.1 mm2/s at about 0.8 kg/l [V S3, S4]), work-roll Rq 0.15 um (Ra 0.11-0.125 um [V S3, S4] x 1.25 [D]), strip Rq 0.2 um. Neat-oil spray header: 28 nozzles at 52 mm pitch, mean spray coefficient 3.4 kW/m2K, the middle of the SIMULATED 2.5-4.3 kW/m2K for kerosene on a work roll [PT-T18, read as an excerpt of a garbled mirror; no measured value on a roll was found] (2 kW/m2K before SPEC14). HEAT PARTITION: strip share 0.22 of the bite heat (each work roll 0.39), the middle of the only MEASURED foil-mill partition, strip 0.11-0.33 / rolls 0.67-0.89 [PT-T16, read as an ABSTRACT ONLY; a net balance, not necessarily the split inside the bite] (0.84 before SPEC14, as in the sheet demo). width.thermal_sensitivity (model_options.thermal_sensitivity full) keeps 0.84 and 2 kW/m2K as rows. PLANTED CAUSES: nozzle 11 (0.62 m) PARTLY blocked at flow level 0.45, and a 20 s closure of the zone valve of nozzles 18-19. Observations were GENERATED FROM THE MODEL ITSELF at the case pass F1 (cells 256, default thermal numerics): band positions = model steady stripe peak and event stripe peak rounded to 1 mm (0.623, 0.988 m); the model bands are LATENT under the 40 MPa mill tension and MANIFEST after tension release, so visible_only_after_tension_release is true and the appearance loose_or_buckle; intermittent duration = model visible time of the event band after tension release rounded to 10 s (310 s at the SPEC14 heat partition and spray coefficient; it was 80 s at strip share 0.84 and 2 kW/m2K: at foil gauge the after-release threshold is about 0.2 um of stripe, so even a 20 s valve closure leaves a band for minutes); continuity both; positions repeat across coils and do not move after a work-roll change; the bands change with coolant zone switching; they do not change after roll wiper cleaning and do not track speed changes (a thermal stripe follows heat input slowly). worse_at_thinner_gauge is left NULL: on this mill the model gauge trend does NOT reproduce it (the onset heights rise toward the thin pass). The case therefore tests the screening logic at foil gauge, not the physics.
notes: Closed-loop demo: planted causes are a partly blocked nozzle (continuous band hidden under mill tension, visible after tension release, nozzle_thermal_stripe) and a cooling-zone valve closure (cooling_zone_switching_transient).

Route: plant statements (50 um input, two single-sheet passes, final usually 17-19 um, down to 12 um); the intermediates 30 um and 25 um, the S1-S3 stock route, the alloy and temper 1235-H18 are the LITERATURE PROPOSAL of the catalogue's grade table (standard grade of the final-gauge bands), to confirm or correct with the plant, not a plant statement. The flow stresses (180 MPa at 18 um, 185 MPa at 12 um) lie inside the proposal's ranges and are unchanged. For the 12 um route the research gives a standard minimum of 180-190 MPa for 1235 / 1060 and 230 MPa for the 1100 / 1C30 type that EV practice favours (GB/T 33143-2022 as read in the second battery survey). All mill and material numbers are synthetic.
At 30 um the mill is in or near closed-gap rolling, which the tool does not model: see the foil-regime block. The lever table and the gauge-control section assume an open gap.

Phase-1 coolant section kept consistent with width_model.spray_header; its geometric screen can only represent a FULLY blocked nozzle, so nozzle 11 is listed as blocked there although width_model gives it flow level 0.45.

worse_at_lower_tension is left null although the model in-mill onset of the stripe falls with tension (6.8 um at 40 MPa, 1.6 um at 8 MPa at the case pass): a band hidden under tension is also "worse at lower tension", so this observation does not separate foil tension lines from a latent thermal stripe.

Final pass F2 0.030 -> 0.018 mm (plant final gauge 17-19 um) and the thinnest product's alternative route ALT1 0.050 -> 0.025 mm and ALT2 0.025 -> 0.012 mm (52 %): the passes below 20 um get experimental mattress bites in the extended domain, flagged; the 12 um bite is expected to lie outside the force range reported for battery-foil passes and is then marked not credible and excluded from every trend statement. Speeds follow published practice: 450-650 m/min on the single-sheet final pass, 550-1000 m/min on earlier passes. The plant rolls the final pass single-sheet (plant statement; material.final_pass_doubled false). material.product battery_collector_foil drives the evidence-neutral product check.

measurement.shapemeter (SPEC17, synthetic): 24 zones of 52 mm centred on the mill centre line, one spray nozzle per zone, no neighbour spreading; it shows what such a shapemeter would read for the modelled bands, not a plant record.

width_model.strip_temperature (SPEC17, synthetic): +3 K at the partly blocked nozzle, an assumption, not a model output; it shows how the strip-temperature term changes the flatness a shapemeter measures hot.

width_model.local_coupling (SPEC19, synthetic): inlet temperature weight 0.5 (the mean of roll and strip surface, an assumption), softening 0.15 %/K (derived from 1100-H18 strengths at 20 and 100 C [PT-T31, PT-T39]) and 10 l/min of oil per nozzle (assumed); it shows the oil viscosity, film, friction, flow stress and strip exit temperature across the width as differences from a healthy header, and changes no score.
